term: absolute emptiness of the eligible maker domain
definition: EmptyFact A e means e is true exactly where every candidate of the SAME eligible maker roster B is absent. This empties all eligible makers, including abstract entities if admitted to B, not merely concrete entities. NeedsMakerAt is the narrow coverage instance for that true negative fact.
note: Stipulated #554 profile. Empty truth plus its coverage and WorldImmanent is inconsistent; each omission has a named sound/factive control. Treating this roster as all reality is an OPEN domain-completeness bridge. A nonexistent candidate in outsideMaking is only an omission control, not an endorsed ontology.
